notes.title: Alpha Build 0.4.03: Shaydee Business
notes.content:
Today's update includes a new quest and a new feature! The ability to sell back items that you no longer need has been a very popular feature request since early access started...

So, meet Shaydee the Goblin! 

[img]http://www.hammerhelm.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/ShaydeeSpeak.png[/img]

Shaydee isn't like other goblins, he doesn't want to fight, he just likes to collect stuff and wants to open a shop. Help Shaydee build his shop outside of town and he'll buy your old weapons and armor from you!

[img]http://www.hammerhelm.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/ShaydeeSell.png[/img]

Quick note: As the game was never balanced with selling back items in mind, Shaydee's prices are currently set a bit low. A full set of Copper Armor, Weapon, and Shield yields just under the amount of gold as killing two spawns of monsters. Sets made from better ore yield more gold. I'll probably be tweaking the prices and the costs of structures over time.

Alpha 0.4.3 includes:
[list][*]A new quest, Shaydee Business
[*]Help Shaydee build his shop and he'll buy weapons and armor from you
[*]If you have placed the Champion's Home, you will respawn outside of the home after you die rather than at the starting location
[*]Added footsteps sound when running on dirt
[*]Added a music mute button
[*]Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the mini mushroommen to get stuck in the air during the Shroomin quest
[/list]

notes.title: New Map Launching 8/22!
notes.content:
[url=http://www.hammerhelm.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/TownNewMap.png][img]http://www.hammerhelm.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/TownNewMap.png[/img][/url]
[b]My town in the distance, loaded into the new map![/b]

The new map will be ready tomorrow afternoon, 8/22! Everything seems to be working, but I want to spend some extra time converting old saves and also just playing through some more quests to make sure all of the new locations work.

There are a few things to consider regarding the new map:

1. You don't have to start a new town. The new map will transfer your town and the townspeople from your current save. However, when you first load, there will be trees in your town. Your townspeople can make short work of these trees or you can cut them down yourself. Once the trees in town are cut down they won't respawn. Your townspeople may act a bit odd for a few minutes (such as running in place and then teleporting if they can't path to a tree that is inside a building) as they acclimate to the new map, but after a bit they will figure it all out. 

2. Any active quests that you had will be removed when you load into the new map. The system should immediately give you a new quest and then afterwards you'll get more quests as usual. Converting the quests to the new map would have delayed the release and opened the game up to a lot of potential bugs.

3. The map is still a work in progress, but the main features are done. I'll be adding more smaller things to the map over time such as more flowers, small trees, mushrooms, more beach items, etc. Some of the trees are a bit too close to each other so I'll be moving those around too. I'll also be adding a couple more POIs as well as adding content to support the new POIs I added already. But the map is in a solid enough shape that I can spend some time adding more quests and content.

Thank you again everyone for your feedback and your patience. The new map took a bit longer than I was expecting but I think the results were worth it!

Your townspeople can make short work of these trees or you can cut them down yourself. Once the trees in town are cut down they won't respawn. Your townspeople may act a bit odd for a few minutes (such as running in place and then teleporting if they can't path to a tree that is inside a building) as they acclimate to the new map, but after a bit they will figure it all out. 

2. Any active quests that you had will be removed when you load into the new map. The system should immediately give you a new quest and then afterwards you'll get more quests as usual. Converting the quests to the new map would have delayed the release and opened the game up to a lot of potential bugs.

3. The map is still a work in progress, but the main features are done. I'll be adding more smaller things to the map over time such as more flowers, small trees, mushrooms, more beach items, etc. Some of the trees are a bit too close to each other so I'll be moving those around too. I'll also be adding a couple more POIs as well as adding content to support the new POIs I added already. But the map is in a solid enough shape that I can spend some time adding more quests and content.

Thank you again everyone for your feedback and your patience. The new map took a bit longer than I was expecting but I think the results were worth it!

notes.title: The Champion's House Update!
notes.content:
Today's update includes the first phase of the Champion's House, a home for you to place and decorate for yourself!

The Champion's House is the largest home in HammerHelm, befitting of your status as the town's Champion. 
[img]http://www.hammerhelm.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/ChampionsHouse.png[/img]

Inside there is ample room to place and store many objects.
[img]http://www.hammerhelm.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/ChampionsHouseInside.png[/img]

Placing an object is easy. Simply right-click it in your inventory and then left click to place. 
[img]http://www.hammerhelm.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/ChampionsHousePlacement.png[/img]

Beds, Dressers, Tables, and more. You can rest in the bed to quickly regain health.
[img]http://www.hammerhelm.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/ChampionsHouseDecorated.png[/img]

More items will be added in the future, including weapon and armor racks that allow you to show off your items, as well as shelves that can display other crafted items, additional light sources, etc.

And yes, that practice dummy in the background of the above screenshot works. :)

[img]http://www.hammerhelm.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/PracticeDummyLargeGif.gif[/img]

Full Patch Notes, Alpha 0.3.11 includes:
[list][*]The Champion's House is now available in the build menu!
[*]Craft interior objects such as beds, tables, and more at the Carpenter
[*]Rest in your bed to quickly regain health
[*]More objects and placement options will be coming in future builds
[*]Structures that require Wooden Houses as prerequisites will now also count Stone Houses
[*]Fixed a bug related to loot in the Strange Activity quest sewers
[*]Monster hit point bar colors are easier to see
[*]Monster hit point bar brightness always remain at the same 
[*]Changed the color of ore deposit hit point bars (light blue) to differentiate them from monsters[/list]

http://steamcommunity.com/app/664000/discussions/0/1471967615861827692/

notes.content:

I'm hoping to be able to show the map soon and will likely put it in the game in a test world so you can check it out before it's done.

notes.title: Alpha Build 0.3.09: Farming and Alchemy Updates
notes.content:
This build includes some changes and fixes to Farms and Alchemy, mostly balance updates based on your feedback. The farm updates are pretty significant but they should make farming more predictable as far as when farmers harvest and how much food your town has.

Alpha 0.3.09 includes:
[list][*]Fixed a bug that sometimes caused farmers to skip a harvest if you played for over a full day (in game time)
[*]If your Farmers are inactive due to a quest (such as Cursed Farms) and they are told to harvest, they will start harvesting as soon as you complete the quest, rather than waiting for the next day
[*]Updated the "Shroomin" Quest so the Mini Mushroom Men don't seek to hide in towers, walls, or entrances
[*]Updated the loot tables for Alchemy resources to balance out which resources you get better
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Stone House upgrades to not persist between saves[/list]
As always, I very much appreciate all of the feedback. It's really cool to have such a positive and engaged community!

notes.title: HammerHelm Development Update
notes.content:
[img]http://www.hammerhelm.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Titlebar_DevUpdate.png[/img]

I wanted to write a quick update on where HammerHelm is and what’s ahead. And by “quick”, I mean a huge wall of text. I suppose I have a lot to share now that HammerHelm is live! :)

I have this broken into three parts, Immediate Term, Short Term, and Long Term. Immediate Term is what I’m doing day to day right now. Short Term are features I want to work on as soon as I can and will probably add some of these over time while I finish out the Immediate Term stuff. And Long Term is features and content that are on my list of things I really want to do, but other stuff takes priority for now. Note that some things may move around so don’t take this as a definitive list of order of priorities.

This is not an exhaustive list either, as there are plenty of smaller things that will get sprinkled in here and there. Also, these are subject to change based on how the game is performing and what you all tell me you like and don’t like. The further out something is, the more likely it could change, so bear that in mind.

[img]http://www.hammerhelm.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Titlebar_ImmediateTerm.png[/img]

[b]Fix bugs[/b] – this kind of goes without saying, but I’m putting it here because it is something that will need attention from time to time. Thankfully there have been very few major bugs and I’ve been able to fix them fairly quickly. HammerHelm is in Alpha though, so there are likely some more bugs hiding out there waiting to be squashed!

[b]Optimize performance[/b] – I actually did a lot of optimizations prior to the Steam launch, including reducing the load time of a large town from about 45 seconds to around 10 seconds. There’s always room for improvement though so this will also be something that is ongoing.

[b]Add more quests[/b] – HammerHelm has a lot of quests, but I want it to have a LOT more. Every building and NPC “job” will have multiple quests associated with it. Quests are a cornerstone of HammerHelm so it’s important that the game continues to reward you for growing your town with new opportunities for adventure. Adding more quests will be my primary focus as far as new content goes.

[b]Add more uses for existing buildings and shopkeepers[/b] - especially in the mid to late game. An example of this is Tavernkeepers telling you rumors or Mages crafting more than just ingredients. Buildings like the Brewery and Infirmary also need to be more useful.

[b]Quest System update[/b] – as I add more quests it will become important to make sure the quest system can keep up. Not all quests are created equal. Some can have a major effect on your town (such as when monsters attack your farms) and others have less of an impact (a mood debuff). The quest system will be updated to handle these quests differently so you aren’t constantly worrying about your town when you are off adventuring.

[img]http://www.hammerhelm.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Titlebar_ShortTerm.png[/img]

[b]Add new buildings, NPCs types, and monsters[/b] – I have some ideas for these but I’d love to hear what you’d like to see added as well! 

[b]Continue to add more quests and features that enhance questing[/b] – similar to the quest work in the Immediate Term list, I plan on adding quests for as long as I can think of new ones. And of course, if you have an idea for a quest please feel free to share it!

[b]Player House with interior decorations[/b] – this is about 25% complete. The house itself is done and I have part of the interior décor placement system working as well. You can see the current system in action in the first half of this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fVlQgag0IDI
[b]Add more things to craft[/b] – Beyond potions, armor, and weapons, I’d like to add things like teleport stones that let you teleport back to town and a host of other miscellaneous and useful items.

[b]Combat system update[/b] – The combat in HammerHelm isn’t where I want it to be yet, but it’s getting closer. Combat needs to be a bit more predictable (meaning when you think you should hit, your attack should hit) and monsters need to be more challenging and varied. So, this includes adding ranged attack and spell casting monsters in addition to updating the existing melee monsters.

[img]http://www.hammerhelm.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Titlebar_LongTerm.png[/img]

[b]Character Customization[/b] – this is a big one. I don’t want to get into too many details, but essentially this boils down to both male and female Dwarves and options like hair and beards.

[b]Redo the world map (I might sneak this into the Short Term if I can)[/b] - I actually don't like the world map. It’s functional and serves its purpose, but it could be a lot better. Right now, it’s a bit too hilly and it’s too big. The game doesn't even use half of the map and that's actually on purpose. About 3 or 4 months ago I moved all of the quest locations to be closer to town because it just wasn’t fun running all the way out there and then running all the way back. Even with more POI on the map, it's still annoying to have to run for 3 or 4 minutes just to get to a quest destination. I actually think a smaller, more focused map would be a lot more fun and it would give a performance boost too. It would also let me make the overall map prettier as well. Reworking the map not only requires the time to make a new map, but I'd also have to retrofit all of the current quest locations. That way when I change the map, you don't have to start over. 

[b]Town Attacks[/b] – I started working on these right before the Steam launch but decided to put it on hold for now. HammerHelm isn’t about defending the town from nightly attacks. It’s an adventure game where a town attack is just ONE thing that can happen. Think of town attacks as a quest, that just happens to be a bit more complicated. 

[img]http://www.hammerhelm.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/WallSmash2.gif[/img]

[b]Travel to other islands[/b] - Travel to other islands that would have different biomes such as lava or winter.

[b]Other NPC Towns[/b] – When visiting other islands, you could discover NPC towns and form relations with them.

[b]Marketplace and trading[/b] – Tied to the above, open trade routes. This also implies a deeper economy for your town and more varied buildings and resource needs.

[b]Story driven quests for Townspeople (ie: learn more about the people in your town)[/b] – I really want to do this, but the time has to be right. This is meant to partly answer the question “What do I do once I’ve built a full town?” – the answer is, building your town is just the beginning! Now you get to learn more about it, learn about the people, and more. Story driven quests would be different than the current quests as they wouldn’t be repeatable and would, as the name implies, have a lot more story behind them. 

Again, this is by no means an exhaustive list of everything I have planned for HammerHelm. Some of these may get done earlier, some may be shelved entirely, replaced by different (and hopefully better!) ideas. Lots of other things could be added in the Immediate Term and the Short Term too as new ideas occur and as the game evolves. I don’t want to list out too much though as I don’t want to promise something that isn’t well thought out. But I’m sure there are things I haven’t mentioned above that will be added to the game. 

I am also very much looking forward to hearing any and all ideas that you may have as that is a big part of the point of being in Early Access. If you do have ideas you’d like to share, please post them in the discussions forum rather than as a comment here. Makes the ideas easier to track and allows other players to chime in as well.

If you got this far, thank you for reading. And thank you for taking this journey with me. I hope HammerHelm meets and exceeds your expectation as it continues to grow!

notes.title: Alpha Build 0.3.03: Player Feedback Update
notes.content:
This update has a bunch of stuff based on your feedback and reports. I feel really lucky to have such a great community!

Alpha 0.3.03 includes:[list]
 [*]VSync can be toggled in the settings menu
 [*]Placing Stone Entrances, Towers, and Walls will eventually create a positive mood buff for townspeople
 [*]Improved loot balance for ore in loot and ore deposits
 [*]Added ore loot as part of the Cave In quest
 [*]Fire Elementals now correctly rise from their idle state
 [*]Inventory items can no longer be stacked above 64
 [*]Fixed a bug that allowed buildings to be placed on top of each other
 [*]It is easier to pick up and move Stone Towers
 [*]Decorative items (such as lamp posts and fountains) can now be moved once placed
 [*]Pressing the "Craft" button before selecting a building no longer puts the UI in a bad state
 [*]Pressing ESC to cancel a build no longer results in losing that building if you are moving an existing building
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha Build 0.3.02: Optimizations and More Farm Updates
notes.content:
This build includes a big optimization to the way the terrain is modified when placing or moving buildings. Also some more updates to Farming as I try to find a happy balance between harvesting and food consumption. Really appreciate the feedback from everyone on this!

Alpha 0.3.02 includes:
[list][*]A new quest: Walking Stone (and a new monster to go with it!)
[*]Crops appear differently depending on whether the farmer is able to harvest them or not. This will help clear up confusion while the farmer is tending, but not harvesting, the crops
[*]Increased the amount of food Farmers deliver to the Storehouse each harvest
[*]Fixed a bug that caused food to go over the Storehouse's maximum capacity
[*]Increased the lighting in dungeons and caves
[*]Jade and Gold can be smelted at the Weaponsmith as well as the Armorsmith
[*]Updated the terrain change system when placing buildings or moving an existing building
[*]Added missing collision to Stone Entrance when first built[/list]

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.3.01: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Just released a new build that fixes a few bugs that players reported last night.
[list] [*]Fixed a bug that caused healthy trees to drop cursed wood after the Cursed Wood quest has been completed
 [*]Fixed a bug that caused stamina to not regenerate after performing a Smash attack
 [*]Fixed a bug that caused stamina to continue to drop if a UI was opened while sprinting
[/list]
Thank you to those of you who posted the bug reports. I very much appreciate it!

I'm also working on an update to Farms and harvesting to make it more obvious when a Farmer should harvest. Right now after planting all of the crops, the Farmer will continue to walk around the farm and tend the crops. This makes it look like the Farmer should be harvesting even though the crops aren't fully ready yet. I wanted to get these fixes in first however so the Farms update will be in the next build.

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.3.0: Farming Improvements
notes.content:
Update 0.3.0 is available and includes a number of improvements and fixes to farming. These changes should keep your town from getting stuck in a loop of never having enough food.
[list][*]Major update to farms and farming to make farmers more predictable with how they harvest and deliver food
[*]Fixed a bug that sometimes caused farmers to stop harvesting and go back to planting after an event (such as a quest that makes them stop farming)
[*]Fixed a similar bug related to farmers not continuing to harvest after saving and reloading the game if they were in the middle of a harvest
[*]Reduced the chance of getting the Cursed Farms quest
[*]Fixed a collision bug with Stone Walls
[/list]
This is a pretty big update to farming and while I've tested it as thoroughly as I can, please be on the lookout for any odd behavior from the farmers in your town. Note that it may take a day or two (in game) for the changes to have a noticeable affect on your town's food resources. But don't worry, NPCs don't starve to death. Lack of food lowers their mood, but once they eat that mood debuff is immediately removed.

notes.title: Alpha Build 0.2.39 - The Necromancer
notes.content:
Added a new quest to the game, the Necromancer Tower. 

These can be discovered in the wilderness and you'll be able to enter the tower to challenge the Necromancer. The battle is essentially a boss fight. The Necromancer spawns Ghosts that attack you and he is immune to your attacks so you have to use his magic against him!

[img]http://www.hammerhelm.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/NecroFightLarge.gif[/img]

I'm planning on adding more to this quest so battling a Necromancer can result in different challenges to face to defeat him. And leaving a Necromancer Tower unchecked will also eventually create more adversity for you and your town such as undead spawning inside the town at night.

Alpha 0.2.39 also includes some more fixes and optimizations. While I am focused on some bigger features like player housing and the town attacks, I'm still making time to continue to add smaller updates to the game.
